name: Hormel Foods
description: Hormel makes and sells branded meat, protein and snack products (SPAM, Jennie-O turkey, Hormel Natural Choice and Black Label, Applegate, Planters, Skippy, Columbus and the MegaMex joint venture) to US retailers, foodservice operators and international customers. About 62 percent of sales are Retail and 33 percent Foodservice; Walmart is about 16 percent of consolidated gross sales less returns. Earnings swing with pork, turkey and other commodity costs and with write-downs: fiscal 2025 operating income fell 33 percent after a $164M non-cash impairment of a minority investment in Indonesia and other charges. It has paid dividends for 392 consecutive quarters.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01); that list does not show industry group or industry.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: About 20,000 active employees, over 90 percent in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Retail
businessLines.how: Sells branded meat, turkey, snack nuts and prepared foods to retailers at a premium over commodity meat; margin is squeezed when pork and turkey input costs rise faster than prices.
businessLines.description: Branded protein and food products sold in US grocery, mass, club, natural, drug, dollar and e-commerce channels; includes the MegaMex Foods joint venture.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit after non-cash impairments; adjusted $496.0M (vs $562.8M FY2024 reported); share is of the three segments' $899.4M

businessLines.name: Foodservice
businessLines.how: Sells customised and standard protein products to distributors and operators in food-away-from-home; higher margin than Retail.
businessLines.description: Products for distributors and operators in restaurants, hospitality, healthcare, K-12, colleges and convenience stores in the US.

revenue.note: vs $3,845.1M FY2024 (+2.5%); growth from customised solutions

businessLines.revenueNote: vs $3,845.1M FY2024 (+2.5%); growth from customised solutions

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Exports and local sales of SPAM and other products, plus royalties and equity earnings from joint ventures abroad.
businessLines.description: Retail and foodservice sales outside the US plus international joint ventures, equity-method investments, royalty arrangements and operations in China and Brazil; Brazil (Ceratti) sold 2026-07-31.

operatingProfit.note: Segment loss after a $164M non-cash impairment of a minority investment in Indonesia; vs profit of $92.1M FY2024

brands.name: Jennie-O
brands.note: Turkey portfolio; a main driver of FY2025 net sales growth (revenue not broken out)

brands.name: SPAM
brands.note: SPAM family of products; a main driver of FY2025 growth (revenue not broken out)

brands.note: Natural and organic meats (revenue not broken out)
